_comment: Registry of accepted deviations from validate_compose_security.py. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired exception counts as a violation again. Review before the expiry date.

no-direct-docker-socket.reason: It IS the restricted proxy — mounts the host socket :ro and exposes only the whitelisted verb groups (CONTAINERS/NETWORKS/INFO/EVENTS/PING/EXEC/POST). Removing the mount removes the control.

cap-drop-all.reason: cap_drop ALL breaks the proxy's unix-socket connect() on Docker Desktop (haproxy 503 SC--) — needs DAC_OVERRIDE-equivalent access to the mounted socket. Effective controls: verb whitelist + socket :ro + no-new-privileges.

healthcheck.reason: tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy (haproxy) ships no healthcheck tooling; liveness is covered by `depends_on: service_started` + a dead proxy failing consumers fast. Revisit if a probe exists upstream.

no-direct-docker-socket.reason: RESIDUAL (SOAR-012): analyzer runner spawns sibling containers via the raw socket. Migrating to a per-consumer restricted proxy is DK-P0-006 — until then this is an accepted, documented risk inside an isolated lab network.
RESIDUAL (SOAR-012): app execution spawns worker containers. Same DK-P0-006 migration pending.
RESIDUAL (SOAR-012): spawns/cleans shuffle-worker containers. Same DK-P0-006 migration pending.
